data.title: Add a bounded first-person room tour
data.summary: An existing room, simple collision and a player capsule. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Godot documents 3D scene formats, export conventions and import configuration.

prerequisites: An authorized Three.js / WebXR environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: An existing room, simple collision and a player capsule.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent first person room workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: An existing room, simple collision and a player capsule. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Reuse the runtime's movement controller and separate collision mesh
Set spawn and return anchors away from geometry intersections
Test walls, stairs, reset and pointer/keyboard focus recovery

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned add a bounded first-person room tour candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: The player cannot walk through the selected blocking walls
Escape and reset restore visible controls
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: A camera moving through geometry is not a tested collision controller.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: Keep a non-pointer-lock alternative for touch and keyboard users.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me add a bounded first-person room tour in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: An existing room, simple collision and a player capsule. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: The player cannot walk through the selected blocking walls; Escape and reset restore visible controls. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
